notes: Both marginal notes were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
The supplied *in* before *the land* is placed on that bare noun under rule 33 rather than on the verb, since *set* already reaches its own object *me*.
The *also* answers to the waw of וְנָתַתָּה under rule 51, the ASV writing no other connective for it.
